page.title: Tell us what you’re planning
page.lead: A house on your own plot, an apartment in one of our buildings, a building for your business, or just a question. We read every message and usually reply within two working days.

actions.whatsappMessage: Hello {{company}}, I have a question about a project.

form.name: Full name
form.subject: What are you planning?
form.messagePlaceholder: Where is it, what do you have in mind, and when would you like to start?
form.note: We use your details only to answer your message. We usually reply within two working days.
form.failed: We couldn’t send your message. Nothing was lost: please try again in a moment, or email or call us.
form.rateLimited: You’ve sent several messages in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
form.spam: Our spam check didn’t go through. Please complete the check again and resend.
form.verify: Please complete the short check above the button first.

validation.name: Please enter your name.
validation.email: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
validation.phone: Use digits, spaces and + ( ) - only, at least 7 digits.
validation.subject: Choose what you’re planning.
validation.message: Tell us a little more (at least 20 characters, {{length}} so far).

toast.failedBody: Your text is still in the form.
toast.savedBody: We’ve received it and will reply soon.

success.title: Thank you, {{name}}.
